entries.title: Proverbs 18:1
segments: ¶He that separateth himself seeketh [his] pleasure, he is vehement against all sound wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:2
segments: ¶A fool hath no delight in understanding, but only that his heart may reveal itself.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:3
segments: ¶When the wicked cometh, there cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:4
segments: ¶The words of a man's mouth are deep waters, [and] the fountain of wisdom is a gushing brook.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:5
segments: ¶It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to wrong the righteous in judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:6
segments: ¶A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for stripes.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:7
segments: A fool's mouth is destruction to him, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:8
segments: ¶The words of a talebearer are as dainty morsels, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:9
segments: ¶He also who is indolent in his work is brother of the destroyer.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:10
segments: ¶The name of Jehovah is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:11
segments: ¶The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as a high wall in his own imagination.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:12
segments: ¶Before destruction the heart of man is haughty; and before honour [goeth] humility.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:13
segments: ¶He that giveth answer before he heareth, it is folly and shame unto him.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:14
segments: ¶The spirit of a man sustaineth his infirmity; but a broken spirit who can bear?

entries.title: Proverbs 18:15
segments: ¶The heart of an intelligent [man] getteth knowledge, and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:16
segments: ¶A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:17
segments: ¶He that is first in his own cause [seemeth] just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:18
segments: ¶The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:19
segments: ¶A brother offended is [harder to be won] than a strong city; and contentions are as the bars of a palace.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:20
segments: ¶A man's belly is satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; with the increase of his lips is he satisfied.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:21
segments: ¶Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:22
segments: ¶Whoso hath found a wife hath found a good thing, and hath obtained favour from Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:23
segments: ¶He that is poor speaketh with supplications, but the rich answereth roughly.

entries.title: Proverbs 18:24
segments: ¶A man of [many] friends will come to ruin but there is a friend [that] sticketh closer than a brother.
